title: 皇后渡口大橋~Queensferry Crossing
focus: 三塔斜張橋以跨中交叉斜索穩定中塔，並以防風屏障、監測與檢查通道確保蘇格蘭海灣的全天候營運~A three-tower cable-stayed bridge whose mid-span crossing stays stabilise the central tower, with wind shielding, monitoring and access for all-weather service
summary: 皇后渡口大橋含引橋全長約 2.7 km，三座約 207 m 高的單柱塔支承 221+650+650+221 m 的斜張橋段，通車時為全球最長的三塔斜張橋，也是規模最大、斜索在跨中交叉的斜張橋。本課從中塔缺乏背索錨固的問題、交叉索的勁度、鋼—混凝土組合橋面與塔基沉箱，經平衡懸臂吊裝與兩處合龍，到防風屏障與車輛穩定、約 2,000 個感測器的監測、積冰掉落與營運檢查交接。~The Queensferry Crossing is about 2.7 km long including approaches; three monopole towers about 207 m tall carry a 221+650+650+221 m cable-stayed section, making it, at opening, the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays that cross at mid-span. The course runs from the central tower’s lack of back-stay anchorage, the stiffness of crossing stays, the composite steel–concrete deck and tower caissons, through balanced-cantilever lifting and two closures, to wind shielding and vehicle stability, monitoring with about 2,000 sensors, falling ice and operational inspection handover.

units.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題~Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system
units.mechanism: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。三塔斜張橋的中塔兩側都是 650 m 的主跨，沒有固定的背跨可以錨索：當活載只作用在其中一跨時，那一跨下垂，中塔被拉向該側，另一跨上拱，結構整體變得很柔。若只靠中塔自身的彎曲勁度抵抗，塔必須非常粗大。皇后渡口大橋的解法是讓三座塔的斜索在兩個主跨的跨中互相交叉重疊，相鄰塔的斜索彼此牽制，使中塔頂端的位移受到相鄰塔與橋面的約束。~In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. In a three-tower bridge the central tower has a 650 m main span on both sides and no fixed back span to anchor to: when live load occupies only one span, that span sags, the central tower is pulled toward it, the other span rises and the whole structure is soft. Resisting this by the central tower’s own bending stiffness alone would demand a massive tower. The Queensferry solution is to let stays from adjacent towers cross and overlap at mid-span of both main spans, so neighbouring towers restrain each other and the central tower head is held by the adjacent towers and the deck.
units.model: 中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。若無交叉索，塔頂等效勁度 k = 20 MN/m，位移 δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m；交叉索使 k 提高到 60 MN/m 時，δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m，降為三分之一。數值為教學假設。~Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Without crossing stays, with an equivalent head stiffness k = 20 MN/m, the displacement is δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m; if crossing stays raise k to 60 MN/m, δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m, one-third as much. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。~Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions.
units.failure: 若中塔勁度不足又沒有交叉索或其他穩定措施，單跨重車隊或不對稱風載會使中塔大幅偏擺，主跨撓度與塔底彎矩超出設計，伸縮縫與鋪面受損；斜索力在兩跨之間大幅來回轉移也會加速疲勞。~A central tower lacking stiffness, with no crossing stays or other stabilisation, sways heavily under a heavy convoy on one span or unbalanced wind, pushing deflections and tower-base moments beyond design and damaging joints and surfacing; large back-and-forth shifts of stay force between spans also accelerate fatigue.
units.misconception: 三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。~A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
units.practice: 多塔斜張橋的設計基準要明列單跨加載、棋盤式加載與不對稱風載等工況，並把中塔頂位移列為主要使用性指標；結構體系比選報告應比較交叉索、加勁中塔與穩定索等方案。~The design basis for a multi-tower bridge should list single-span, alternate-span and unbalanced wind cases and make central-tower displacement a key serviceability indicator; the system study should compare crossing stays, a stiffened central tower and stabilising cables.

units.anchor: 跨中交叉斜索~Mid-span crossing stays
units.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度~Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays
units.mechanism: 交叉斜索的作用像一條條斜向的彈簧：當中塔被拉向一側時，從相鄰塔伸到跨中、並錨在重疊區的斜索會被拉長，產生反向的水平分力，把中塔與橋面拉回。每根斜索提供的水平勁度與鋼截面積、彈性模數成正比，與索長成反比，並乘上水平夾角餘弦的平方，所以較平、較短的索效率較好。重疊段越長，參與牽制的索越多，但同一段橋面上兩組斜索的錨固點也越密集，增加錨固與檢修的複雜度。設計者以全橋分析在勁度與構造之間取得平衡。~Crossing stays act like inclined springs: when the central tower is pulled to one side, stays from the adjacent tower reaching into the overlap zone at mid-span are stretched and produce an opposing horizontal component that pulls the tower and deck back. Each stay’s horizontal stiffness is proportional to its steel area and modulus, inversely proportional to its length, and multiplied by the square of the cosine of its angle, so flatter and shorter stays are more effective. A longer overlap brings more stays into play but crowds two sets of anchorages on the same stretch of deck, complicating anchorage and maintenance. Designers balance stiffness against detailing with global analysis.
units.model: 單索水平勁度 k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L。取 E = 195 GPa、A = 75 股×150 mm² = 11,250 mm²、θ = 20°（cos²θ ≈ 0.883）、L = 400 m：k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m。16 根交叉索合計約 77 MN/m，若橋面柔性使有效率只有 50%，增加約 39 MN/m，使單元 1 的 20 MN/m 提高到約 59 MN/m。數值為教學假設。~Single-stay horizontal stiffness k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L. With E = 195 GPa, A = 75 strands×150 mm² = 11,250 mm², θ = 20° (cos²θ ≈ 0.883) and L = 400 m, k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m. Sixteen crossing stays total about 77 MN/m; if deck flexibility makes them only 50% effective, they add about 39 MN/m, raising unit 1’s 20 MN/m to about 59 MN/m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。~Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline.
units.failure: 若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。~Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load.
units.misconception: 斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。~The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head.
units.practice: 交叉區的錨固細部要以局部模型與疲勞評估確認，並為兩組斜索各自保留檢修與更換空間；索力驗收表應把交叉索列為獨立一組，容許偏差可比一般索更嚴格。~Verify crossing-zone anchorage details with local models and fatigue assessment and keep access and replacement space for both sets of stays; list crossing stays as a separate group in the force acceptance table, possibly with tighter tolerances than other stays.

units.anchor: 組合槽型梁~Composite steel tub deck
units.title: 鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接~Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection
units.mechanism: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面寬約 39.8 m，由鋼梁（槽型箱）加上鋼筋混凝土橋面板組成；營運單位說明橋面鋼槽內設有檢修走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km。組合橋面讓混凝土承受壓力與局部輪載，鋼梁承受拉力與整體彎曲，兩者以剪力釘連成一體。斜張橋的組合橋面還要承受斜索水平分力累積的巨大軸壓，越靠近塔軸壓越大；混凝土在軸壓下的徐變與乾縮會把力量逐漸轉移給鋼梁，剪力連接件需承受這種長期重分配的界面剪力。~The Queensferry deck is about 39.8 m wide, made of steel girders in tub-box form with a reinforced concrete deck slab; the operator notes walkways inside the steel tubs, one about 2.7 km long. In a composite deck the concrete takes compression and local wheel loads, the steel takes tension and global bending, and shear studs make them act together. A cable-stayed composite deck also carries large axial compression accumulated from the horizontal stay components, highest near the towers; creep and shrinkage of the concrete under this compression gradually transfer force to the steel, and the shear connectors must carry the interface shear from this long-term redistribution.
units.model: 界面縱向剪力流 v_L = V·Q/I。取斷面剪力 V = 5,000 kN、Q/I = 0.25 m⁻¹：v_L = 5,000×0.25 = 1,250 kN/m；每支剪力釘設計強度 100 kN 時，每公尺需約 1,250/100 = 12.5 支，即每公尺 13 支。數值為教學假設。~Interface longitudinal shear flow v_L = V·Q/I. With section shear V = 5,000 kN and Q/I = 0.25 m⁻¹, v_L = 5,000×0.25 = 1,250 kN/m; at 100 kN design resistance per stud, about 1,250/100 = 12.5 studs per metre are needed, so 13 per metre. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 剪力釘焊接後抽樣做敲彎試驗，橋面板澆置前檢查釘的數量與位置；以時間相依分析計算徐變與乾縮造成的鋼梁應力增量，與施工中在鋼梁上量測的應變比較；橋面板裂縫寬度定期量測並記錄。~After stud welding, bend-test a sample and check stud numbers and positions before the slab is cast; compute steel stress increments from creep and shrinkage by time-dependent analysis and compare with strains measured on the girders during construction; measure and record slab crack widths periodically.
units.failure: 剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。~Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force; through cracks from shrinkage and temperature left untreated let de-icing salt reach and corrode the reinforcement and the top flange.
units.misconception: 組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。~In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
units.practice: 組合橋面的施工順序（鋼梁架設、橋面板澆置、斜索張拉）要在施工控制模型中逐步模擬，並規定混凝土齡期與張拉時程的關係；防水層與排水細部須在橋面板完成後立即施作。~Model the sequence of steel erection, slab casting and stay stressing step by step in construction control, linking concrete age to the stressing schedule; install waterproofing and drainage details immediately after the slab is complete.

units.anchor: 南北塔臨時鋼沉箱~Temporary steel caissons
units.title: 海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰~Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam
units.mechanism: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，南北兩座塔基以臨時鋼沉箱施作，中塔則以圍堰圍住，基礎完成後臨時構造都已移除，讓塔看起來直接從海中升起。鋼沉箱下沉到河床並坐落在岩盤或承載層後，先以水下灌注的封底混凝土封住底部，再抽水在乾燥環境中澆築基礎。封底混凝土的厚度取決於外部水頭：抽乾後，水壓從下方向上推，封底的自重加上與壁面的摩擦必須足以平衡，否則封底會上浮或破裂。~Project newsletters state that the north and south tower foundations were built inside temporary steel caissons and the central tower inside a cofferdam, with the temporary works removed afterwards so the towers appear to rise straight from the sea. A steel caisson is sunk to the bed and seated on rock or the bearing stratum, the base is sealed with tremie concrete placed underwater, and the water is then pumped out so the foundation can be cast in the dry. The seal thickness depends on the external head: once dewatered, water pressure pushes up from below, and the seal’s self-weight plus friction on the walls must balance it or the seal will lift or crack.
units.model: 封底底面水壓 p = γ_w·h。水頭 h = 20 m 時 p = 9.81×20 ≈ 196 kPa；若僅以封底自重平衡、混凝土單位重 24 kN/m³，所需厚度 t = 196/24 ≈ 8.2 m；計入壁面摩擦或以錨樁抗浮可明顯減薄。水頭為教學假設。~Water pressure under the seal p = γ_w·h. With a 20 m head, p = 9.81×20 ≈ 196 kPa; balancing by self-weight alone with concrete at 24 kN/m³ needs t = 196/24 ≈ 8.2 m, which wall friction or tension anchors can reduce considerably. The head is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 沉箱下沉過程量測傾斜、刃口高程與河床接觸；封底灌注後以鑽芯或潛水檢查完整性，抽水時分階段降低水位並監測封底上浮、滲水量與沉箱變形，任何異常立即停止抽水。~While sinking, monitor caisson tilt, cutting-edge level and bed contact; after the seal pour check integrity by coring or divers; dewater in stages while monitoring seal uplift, seepage and caisson deformation, stopping immediately at any anomaly.
units.failure: 封底厚度不足或灌注夾泥，抽水時封底可能突然上浮或破裂，海水湧入淹沒沉箱並危及作業人員；沉箱傾斜坐落則使基礎偏位，影響塔的幾何。~An insufficient or contaminated seal can suddenly lift or crack during dewatering, flooding the caisson and endangering the crew; a caisson seated at a tilt displaces the foundation and affects tower geometry.
units.misconception: 沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。~Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
units.practice: 沉箱與圍堰屬臨時工程，需有獨立的設計、檢查與簽認；抽水程序要列出分階段水位、量測項目與停止條件，並把封底驗收設為停留檢查點。~Caissons and cofferdams are temporary works needing their own design, checking and sign-off; the dewatering procedure should list staged water levels, measurements and stop criteria, with acceptance of the seal a hold point.

units.title: 三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝~Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers
units.mechanism: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面鋼節段在中國與西班牙製造、海運到場，再從三座塔各向兩側以平衡懸臂吊裝，同時有六個懸臂前緣推進。每個節段吊上後焊接或栓接，安裝對應斜索並張拉，再澆築或安裝橋面板。六個前緣同時作業可縮短工期，但每座塔都必須保持兩側平衡，海灣的潮流、風與航道限制吊裝窗口；某一前緣延誤時，必須檢查其他前緣是否能繼續而不造成過大的不平衡。施工控制團隊要同時管理三組懸臂的幾何與索力。~The Queensferry deck segments were made in China and Spain, shipped to site and lifted as balanced cantilevers from each of the three towers in both directions, with six cantilever fronts advancing at once. Each segment is lifted, welded or bolted, its stays installed and stressed, and its deck slab cast or placed. Six fronts shorten the programme, but every tower must stay balanced, and tides, wind and shipping limit lifting windows; when one front falls behind, the team must check whether the others can continue without excessive imbalance. Construction control must manage the geometry and stay forces of three sets of cantilevers at once.
units.model: 斜張橋段 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m，以 12 m 節段計約需 1,742/12 ≈ 145 個（公開資料列約 149 個）；六個前緣平均分攤約 145/6 ≈ 24 個，若每個前緣每 4 天完成一個循環，約需 24×4 ≈ 97 天的純吊裝時間。循環時間為教學假設。~The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m; in 12 m segments it needs about 1,742/12 ≈ 145 segments (public sources cite about 149). Shared among six fronts, each handles about 145/6 ≈ 24; at one cycle every 4 days per front, net lifting takes about 24×4 ≈ 97 days. Cycle time is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每個吊裝循環後量測懸臂端高程、軸線與塔頂偏位，並與施工控制模型比較；建立六個前緣的進度與不平衡追蹤表，任何前緣超出容許不平衡即暫停相對側作業；吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道協調。~After each cycle survey cantilever-tip level, alignment and tower-head displacement and compare with the control model; keep a progress and imbalance tracker for all six fronts, pausing the opposite side when any front exceeds the allowable imbalance; confirm wind, tide and shipping coordination before each lift.
units.failure: 若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。~If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits; fabrication errors not caught at the factory surface as mismatched joints on site, causing delay and residual stress from forced fit-up.
units.misconception: 多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。~With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently.
units.practice: 節段在工廠要做預拼裝與尺寸驗收，海運前記錄重量與幾何；施工控制計畫應有六個前緣的整體排程、不平衡上限與延誤時的處置規則，並每日更新。~Pre-assemble and dimensionally accept segments at the factory and record weight and geometry before shipping; the construction-control plan should hold a combined schedule for all six fronts, imbalance limits and rules for delays, updated daily.

units.anchor: 兩處跨中合龍~Two mid-span closures
units.title: 兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正~Closing two main spans and correcting levels
units.mechanism: 三塔體系有兩個 650 m 主跨，每跨都在跨中由兩側懸臂會合。由於兩跨共用中塔，一跨合龍時的強制調整會經中塔影響另一跨；而且交叉斜索的錨點在跨中重疊，合龍段附近的斜索力與高程互相牽連。合龍前兩個懸臂端的高差來自製造誤差、溫度差、日照與風，通常以調整附近幾根斜索的索力、加減臨時配重或以千斤頂微調來消除，再以臨時鎖定裝置固定並完成接合。合龍順序與每一步的調整量必須事先模擬。~A three-tower system has two 650 m main spans, each closed at mid-span where cantilevers from both sides meet. Because both spans share the central tower, forced adjustments at one closure travel through the tower to the other span, and since crossing stays anchor in the overlap at mid-span, stay forces and levels near the closure are interlinked. Level differences between tips before closure come from fabrication error, temperature, sunshine and wind, and are usually removed by adjusting forces in a few nearby stays, adding or removing temporary ballast or fine jacking, then fixing the tips with temporary locks before joining. The closure order and every adjustment step must be simulated in advance.
units.model: 若影響係數顯示附近某根斜索每增加 100 kN 可使懸臂端上升 15 mm，消除 90 mm 高差需增加 90/15×100 = 600 kN；若改由兩根索分擔、每根影響係數 10 mm/100 kN，則各需約 450 kN。數值為教學假設。~If influence coefficients show that each extra 100 kN in a nearby stay lifts the tip 15 mm, removing a 90 mm difference needs 90/15×100 = 600 kN more; sharing the correction between two stays at 10 mm per 100 kN each requires about 450 kN in each. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端高程、間距、溫度與風速，選在溫度穩定的時段；每一步索力調整後量測高程與塔頂位移，與影響矩陣預測比較；第一處合龍完成後重新量測第二跨，再決定其調整量。~Before closure log both tip levels, gap, temperature and wind continuously and choose a thermally stable window; after each stay adjustment measure levels and tower displacement against influence-matrix predictions; after the first closure, resurvey the second span before deciding its adjustments.
units.failure: 若兩處合龍各自為政，第一跨的強制調整讓中塔偏移，第二跨的高差因而變大，最後需更大的強制力才能合龍，留下殘餘應力；臨時鎖定不足時，日溫變化可能在焊接期間拉開接頭。~Treating the two closures independently lets forced adjustment at the first span tilt the central tower and enlarge the level gap at the second, requiring even larger forcing and leaving residual stress; inadequate temporary locks let daily temperature change pull the joint open during welding.
units.misconception: 每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。~Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
units.practice: 合龍計畫要包含兩跨的整體順序、每一步的索力調整量與量測點、溫度與風速作業窗口，以及中止與回復程序；兩處合龍都設為停留檢查點，由設計與施工控制工程師共同簽認。~The closure plan should cover the order for both spans, each step’s stay adjustments and survey points, temperature and wind windows, and abort and recovery procedures; both closures are hold points signed jointly by the designer and construction-control engineer.

units.title: 防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全~Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety
units.mechanism: 相鄰的福斯公路大橋在強風時常需限制高側車輛或封橋，影響蘇格蘭東部交通。皇后渡口大橋在兩側車道設置防風屏障，交通部門說明其設計目的是讓大橋在風速達約 115 mph（約 51 m/s）時仍能保持開放。屏障降低車道高度的風速與紊流，減少高側車輛的側向力與翻覆力矩；但屏障本身也增加橋面迎風面積與氣動阻力，並可能改變斷面的渦振特性，因此必須與橋面一起進行風洞試驗，在行車安全與結構風荷載之間取得平衡。~The neighbouring Forth Road Bridge often had to restrict high-sided vehicles or close in strong winds, disrupting traffic in eastern Scotland. The Queensferry Crossing has wind shielding along both carriageways, which the transport agency says is designed to keep the bridge open in winds up to about 115 mph (about 51 m/s). The shielding lowers wind speed and turbulence at lane level, reducing side force and overturning moment on high-sided vehicles, but it also adds windward area and drag to the deck and can change the section’s vortex behaviour, so it must be wind-tunnel tested with the deck to balance traffic safety against structural wind load.
units.model: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s，q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa；高側車側面積 30 m²、側力係數 1.0 時 F ≈ 48.6 kN，作用高 2.0 m 的翻覆力矩約 97 kN·m。若屏障使車道風速減半為 25.7 m/s，F ≈ 12.1 kN、力矩約 24 kN·m，只有原來的四分之一。車輛參數與減風比為教學假設。~115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s, so q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa; for a high-sided vehicle with 30 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.0, F ≈ 48.6 kN and the overturning moment at 2.0 m height is about 97 kN·m. If shielding halves lane-level wind to 25.7 m/s, F ≈ 12.1 kN and the moment is about 24 kN·m, a quarter of the original. Vehicle values and the reduction ratio are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以含屏障的斷面模型風洞試驗量測橋面氣動係數與渦振，並在模型車道高度量測風速折減；以車輛模型量測側力與翻覆係數；通車後以橋上風速計記錄屏障內外風速，驗證折減比並建立交通管制門檻。~Test section models with shielding to measure deck aerodynamic coefficients and vortex response and the wind reduction at lane height; measure side-force and overturning coefficients on vehicle models; after opening log anemometers inside and outside the shielding to confirm the reduction ratio and set traffic-control thresholds.
units.failure: 若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。~Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts; fatigue failure of shield fixings can drop panels.
units.misconception: 防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。~The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles.
units.practice: 營運單位應把橋上風速與交通管制門檻寫入標準作業程序，並定期檢查屏障面板與固定件；任何屏障修改都需由風工程顧問評估對橋面氣動與車輛安全的影響。~The operator should write deck wind speeds and traffic-control thresholds into standard procedures and inspect shield panels and fixings regularly; any shielding modification needs the wind consultant’s assessment of deck aerodynamics and vehicle safety.

units.anchor: 雲端結構健康監測~Cloud-based health monitoring
units.title: 約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀~Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation
units.mechanism: 設計團隊公開資料指出，皇后渡口大橋約有 2,000 個感測器即時監測整體行為，資料送入雲端結構健康監測系統。交通部門說明路面在橋上沒有中間伸縮縫，行車因而平順，這代表溫度造成的伸縮集中在兩端的伸縮縫與支承，伸縮縫開口與溫度的關係就成為最直接的健康指標之一：若關係線斜率改變或出現遲滯，可能代表支承卡滯、阻尼器失效或結構約束改變。監測資料也用來比對設計預測的應變、索力與加速度，累積長期基準。~The design team states that about 2,000 sensors monitor the Queensferry Crossing’s global behaviour in real time, feeding a cloud-based structural health monitoring system. The transport agency notes there are no intermediate road-level joints on the bridge, giving a smooth ride; this means thermal movement concentrates at the end joints and bearings, so the relation between joint opening and temperature becomes one of the most direct health indicators: a change in slope or new hysteresis may signal seized bearings, failed dampers or changed restraint. The data are also compared with predicted strains, stay forces and accelerations to build long-term baselines.
units.model: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取組合橋面 α = 1.1×10⁻⁵/°C、自不動點到端部 L = 1,350 m：每 1 °C 伸縮約 1.1×10⁻⁵×1,350,000 mm ≈ 14.9 mm，ΔT = 45 °C 時約 0.67 m。實測斜率若只有約 10 mm/°C，表示約三分之一的伸縮被阻擋。數值為教學假設。~Movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With α = 1.1×10⁻⁵/°C for the composite deck and L = 1,350 m from the fixed point to the end, each 1 °C gives about 1.1×10⁻⁵×1,350,000 mm ≈ 14.9 mm, and ΔT = 45 °C gives about 0.67 m. A measured slope of only about 10 mm/°C would mean about a third of the movement is being restrained. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以有效橋面溫度（多點溫度計加權）對伸縮縫位移做回歸，每季更新斜率與殘差；同時比對支承位移、阻尼器行程與塔頂偏位，確認約束行為一致；感測器每年校正，異常讀值以人工量測複核。~Regress joint displacement against effective deck temperature from weighted multi-point thermometers and update the slope and residuals quarterly; cross-check bearing displacement, damper stroke and tower-head displacement for consistent restraint behaviour; calibrate sensors yearly and verify anomalous readings manually.
units.failure: 支承或伸縮縫卡滯時，溫度伸縮被阻擋，在橋面與塔產生額外內力；若監測只看原始讀數而不做溫度回歸，這種漸進的卡滯可能多年未被發現，直到構件損壞。~Seized bearings or joints restrain thermal movement and create extra forces in deck and towers; if monitoring looks only at raw readings without temperature regression, such gradual seizure can go unnoticed for years until a component fails.
units.misconception: 監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。~More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
units.practice: 監測交接應包含每個感測器的位置、量測物理量、溫度補償方法、基準值與警戒值，以及資料異常時的人工複核流程；年度報告以趨勢與殘差呈現，並由結構工程師簽署。~Monitoring handover should include each sensor’s location, measured quantity, temperature compensation, baseline and alert values and the manual verification procedure for anomalies; annual reports present trends and residuals and are signed by a structural engineer.

units.anchor: 塔與斜索積冰~Ice on towers and stays
units.title: 積冰掉落的風險與營運對策~Falling-ice risk and operational response
units.mechanism: 2020 年 2 月 11 日，皇后渡口大橋通車約 30 個月後首次全面封橋，原因是塔上積冰掉落到車道並砸損 8 輛車。高聳的塔與斜索在凍雨、濕雪與低溫高濕的天氣中會結冰，日照或氣溫回升時冰層鬆脫，從百公尺以上高度落下，對車輛與人員構成直接危險。冰塊的質量與墜落高度決定撞擊能量，因此對策包括氣象預警、即時監測積冰狀態、降速或封閉車道，以及長期研究塔與斜索表面的防冰或除冰措施。~On 11 February 2020, about 30 months after opening, the Queensferry Crossing closed fully for the first time because ice falling from the towers onto the carriageway damaged eight vehicles. Tall towers and stays accrete ice in freezing rain, wet snow and cold humid weather, and when sunshine or rising temperature loosens it, it falls from heights above 100 m, a direct danger to vehicles and people. Ice mass and fall height determine impact energy, so responses include weather warnings, real-time monitoring of icing, speed restrictions or lane closures, and longer-term study of anti-icing or de-icing measures for tower and stay surfaces.
units.model: 外徑 200 mm 的斜索包覆 20 mm 冰層，截面積 π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m²，以冰密度 900 kg/m³ 計每公尺約 12.4 kg。2 kg 冰塊自 100 m 落下（忽略空氣阻力），速度 √(2gh) ≈ 44.3 m/s，動能 = m·g·h ≈ 2×9.81×100 ≈ 1,960 J；實際受空氣阻力會較低。數值為教學假設。~A 200 mm stay with 20 mm of radial ice has an ice area of π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m², about 12.4 kg per metre at 900 kg/m³. A 2 kg piece falling 100 m, ignoring drag, reaches √(2gh) ≈ 44.3 m/s with kinetic energy m·g·h ≈ 2×9.81×100 ≈ 1,960 J; air drag lowers this in reality. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以橋上氣象站的溫度、濕度、降水與風速建立積冰風險指標，搭配攝影機或積冰感測器觀察實際積冰；每次事件記錄冰塊大小、落點與天氣條件，用來修正預警門檻與交通管制決策。~Build an icing-risk index from on-bridge temperature, humidity, precipitation and wind, combined with cameras or ice sensors to observe actual accretion; record ice size, landing positions and weather for each event to refine warning thresholds and traffic decisions.
units.failure: 若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。~Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes; overly cautious closures cause major disruption and economic loss.
units.misconception: 積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。~Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
units.practice: 營運手冊應有積冰事件的分級應變程序：預警條件、巡查、降速、封閉車道與全面封橋的決策權責，以及事件後檢查斜索套管與屏障是否受損。~The operations manual should have a graded ice-event procedure covering warning conditions, patrols, speed limits, lane and full closures with clear decision authority, plus post-event checks of stay ducts and shielding for damage.

units.anchor: 橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道~2.7 km internal walkway
units.title: 檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接~Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover
units.mechanism: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，橋面鋼槽內設有走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km，讓檢查人員在不封閉車道的情況下沿橋面內部巡查焊道、剪力連接與排水。斜張橋的長期維護重點包括 288 根斜索的錨具與套管、交叉區的錨固細部、塔內通道、伸縮縫與支承，以及防風屏障。英國公路結構物的檢查制度通常把例行的一般檢查與較深入的主要檢查分開安排，交接時要把每個構件的檢查方法、通道與基準狀態寫清楚，讓營運單位能在數十年內持續執行。~Project newsletters note walkways inside the steel deck tubs, one about 2.7 km long, letting inspectors patrol welds, shear connection and drainage inside the deck without closing lanes. Long-term maintenance of a cable-stayed bridge centres on the anchorages and ducts of all 288 stays, the anchorage details in the crossing zones, tower access, joints and bearings, and the wind shielding. UK highway-structure inspection regimes usually separate routine general inspections from deeper principal inspections, and handover must record each component’s inspection method, access and baseline condition so the operator can sustain the regime for decades.
units.model: 若 288 根斜索的近距離主要檢查以 6 年為一循環，每年需檢查 288/6 = 48 根，約每週 1 根；若改為 2 年一般檢查加 6 年主要檢查，且一般檢查以望遠鏡或無人機涵蓋全部斜索，主要檢查負荷不變。循環年數為教學假設。~If close principal inspection of all 288 stays runs on a 6-year cycle, 288/6 = 48 stays must be inspected a year, about one a week; adding 2-yearly general inspections that cover every stay by binoculars or drone leaves the principal-inspection workload unchanged. Cycle lengths are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前完成全橋基準檢查（含斜索套管、錨具、焊道與塗裝），並以照片與數位模型記錄位置；營運後每次檢查的結果與基準比較，劣化趨勢超過門檻即排入維修計畫；檢查通道本身也要定期檢查照明、通風與安全設施。~Before handover complete a baseline inspection of the whole bridge, including stay ducts, anchorages, welds and coatings, recorded with photographs and a digital model; compare each later inspection with the baseline and schedule repairs when deterioration trends exceed thresholds; inspect the access routes themselves for lighting, ventilation and safety equipment.
units.failure: 若設計時沒有提供足夠的檢查通道，錨具與交叉區細部無法近距離檢查，劣化可能在多年後才被發現；交接資料不完整時，營運單位不知道哪些構件有特殊檢查需求，檢查只能流於表面。~Without adequate access designed in, anchorages and crossing-zone details cannot be inspected closely and deterioration may surface only years later; incomplete handover leaves the operator unaware of components with special inspection needs, so inspections stay superficial.
units.misconception: 新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。~A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含檢查與維護手冊、構件清單與編號、通道圖、基準檢查報告、感測器與監測資料格式，以及特殊構件（斜索、阻尼器、屏障）的更換方法；營運與設計單位應在通車後數年內進行一次聯合檢討。~Handover should include the inspection and maintenance manual, component list and numbering, access drawings, baseline inspection report, sensor and data formats, and replacement methods for special components such as stays, dampers and shielding; operator and designer should hold a joint review a few years after opening.

example: 設計練習：比較三塔斜張橋在單跨加載時，以交叉索或加粗中塔兩種方式控制中塔頂位移。設單跨活載造成中塔頂不平衡水平力 H = 30 MN，目標位移 δ ≤ 0.5 m，所需總勁度 k = H/δ = 60 MN/m。方案 A：塔本身勁度 20 MN/m，另以交叉索補足 40 MN/m；若每根交叉索有效水平勁度約 4.8×0.5 = 2.4 MN/m，需約 40/2.4 ≈ 17 根。方案 B：完全靠塔，懸臂塔頂勁度 k = 3EI/h³，取 h = 200 m、E = 35 GPa，所需 I = k·h³/(3E) = 60,000 kN/m×8.0×10⁶ m³/(3×3.5×10⁷ kN/m²) ≈ 4,570 m⁴，約為 20 MN/m 對應 I ≈ 1,520 m⁴ 的三倍，塔斷面將大幅加粗。若目標放寬到 δ ≤ 0.75 m，所需 k = 40 MN/m，交叉索只需約 20/2.4 ≈ 9 根。數值為教學假設，非本橋設計值。~Design exercise: compare crossing stays with a stiffer central tower for controlling central-tower displacement under one-span loading. Live load on one span applies H = 30 MN at the central tower head; for δ ≤ 0.5 m the required stiffness is k = H/δ = 60 MN/m. Option A: the tower supplies 20 MN/m and crossing stays add 40 MN/m; at about 4.8×0.5 = 2.4 MN/m effective horizontal stiffness per crossing stay, about 40/2.4 ≈ 17 stays are needed. Option B: the tower alone, with cantilever head stiffness k = 3EI/h³; with h = 200 m and E = 35 GPa, the required I = k·h³/(3E) = 60,000 kN/m×8.0×10⁶ m³/(3×3.5×10⁷ kN/m²) ≈ 4,570 m⁴, three times the I ≈ 1,520 m⁴ that gives 20 MN/m, so the tower section grows greatly. Relaxing the target to δ ≤ 0.75 m needs k = 40 MN/m, and only about 20/2.4 ≈ 9 crossing stays. Values are teaching assumptions, not this bridge’s design.
history: 為減輕 1964 年啟用的福斯公路大橋的交通與耐久壓力，蘇格蘭政府推動福斯替代跨越計畫：2008 年 1 月委任 Jacobs 與 Arup 聯合體擔任設計顧問，完成標準設計與合約文件；2011 年 4 月以約 7.9 億英鎊把主合約授予由 Dragados、Hochtief、American Bridge 與 Morrison 組成的 FCBC，細部設計由 Ramboll 主導的聯合體負責。大橋於 2017 年 8 月 30 日通車，9 月 4 日由英國女王正式啟用，成為全球最長的三塔斜張橋與規模最大的跨中交叉索斜張橋，2018 年 2 月升格為高速公路。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。~To relieve traffic and durability pressure on the Forth Road Bridge of 1964, the Scottish Government launched the Forth Replacement Crossing: in January 2008 the Jacobs Arup joint venture was appointed to prepare the specimen design and contract documents, and in April 2011 the principal contract of about £790 million went to FCBC, comprising Dragados, Hochtief, American Bridge and Morrison, with detailed design by a Ramboll-led joint venture. The bridge opened to traffic on 30 August 2017 and was formally opened by the Queen on 4 September, becoming the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays crossing at mid-span; it became a motorway in February 2018. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
facts: 含引橋全長約 2.7 km~Total length including approaches is about 2.7 km
斜張橋段 221+650+650+221 m，兩個主跨各約 650 m~The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 m with two main spans of about 650 m
三座單柱混凝土塔各高約 207 m~The three concrete monopole towers are each about 207 m tall
全橋約 288 根斜索，跨中交叉重疊~There are about 288 stays, crossing and overlapping at mid-span
橋面寬約 39.8 m，為鋼—混凝土組合斷面~The deck is about 39.8 m wide with a composite steel–concrete section
防風屏障設計使大橋在約 115 mph（約 51 m/s）風速下仍可通行~Wind shielding is designed to keep the bridge open in winds up to about 115 mph (about 51 m/s)
主合約約 7.9 億英鎊，整體計畫約 13.25 至 13.5 億英鎊~The principal contract was about £790 million within a scheme of about £1.325 to £1.35 billion
約 2,000 個感測器接入雲端結構健康監測系統~About 2,000 sensors feed a cloud-based structural health monitoring system
計畫同時升級 19.7 km 道路並新建 4 km 連絡道路~The scheme also upgraded 19.7 km of roads and built 4 km of new connecting roads

timeline.event: 1 月委任 Jacobs 與 Arup 聯合體擔任設計顧問~In January the Jacobs Arup joint venture is appointed as design consultant
4 月以約 7.9 億英鎊授予 FCBC 主合約~In April the principal contract of about £790 million is awarded to FCBC
8 月 30 日通車，9 月 4 日由英國女王正式啟用~Opens to traffic on 30 August and is formally opened by the Queen on 4 September
2 月 1 日升格為高速公路並適用全線速限~Becomes a motorway on 1 February with full motorway speed limits
2 月 11 日因塔上積冰掉落砸損 8 輛車首次封橋~Closes for the first time on 11 February after falling ice damages eight vehicles

codes: EN 1994-2 歐洲規範 4 第 2 部：鋼—混凝土組合橋~EN 1994-2 Eurocode 4 Part 2: Composite steel and concrete bridges
EN 1991-1-4 結構作用：風作用~EN 1991-1-4 Actions on structures: Wind actions
英國道路與橋梁設計手冊 CS 450 公路結構物檢查~UK Design Manual for Roads and Bridges CS 450 Inspection of highway structures
landmarks: 福斯公路大橋~Forth Road Bridge
里翁—安提里翁大橋~Rion–Antirion Bridge

sources.title: 蘇格蘭交通部：福斯替代跨越計畫細節
sources.titleEn: Transport Scotland: Forth Replacement Crossing project details
sources.scope: 業主說明三塔與跨中交叉索的紀錄、合約授予與通車日期、連絡道路與智慧運輸系統規模。
sources.scopeEn: Owner page on the three-tower and crossing-stay records, contract award and opening dates, and the scale of connecting roads and ITS.

sources.title: 蘇格蘭交通部：2017 年 10 月專案通訊
sources.scope: 最終期專案通訊，說明防風屏障設計風速、無中間伸縮縫的路面、橋面箱內走道與塔基臨時沉箱及圍堰。
sources.scopeEn: Final project newsletter on the wind-shielding design speed, joint-free road surface, walkways inside the deck tubs and temporary caissons and cofferdam at the towers.

sources.title: Arup：皇后渡口大橋專案頁
sources.scope: 設計顧問說明標準設計、合約文件、專案管理與約 2,000 個感測器的結構健康監測。
sources.scopeEn: Design consultant’s page on the specimen design, contract documents, project management and structural health monitoring with about 2,000 sensors.

sources.title: 維基百科：皇后渡口大橋（英文）
sources.scope: 塔高、節段來源、承包與設計團隊與 2020 年積冰封橋的概覽。
sources.scopeEn: Overview of tower height, segment origins, contracting and design teams and the 2020 ice closure.

sources.title: Structurae：皇后渡口大橋資料
sources.scope: 結構資料庫列出的分跨、塔高、橋面寬與斜索數量，作為延伸閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Structural database entry with span layout, tower height, deck width and stay count for further reading.

vendors.name: 豪赫蒂夫（Hochtief）
vendors.business: 德國營建集團，為 FCBC 承包聯營成員。
vendors.businessEn: German construction group, a member of the FCBC contracting consortium.
vendors.role: 大型海上斜張橋施工聯營的組織與風險分擔
vendors.roleEn: Organisation and risk sharing in a joint venture building a major marine cable-stayed bridge

vendors.name: ACS 集團（Dragados）
vendors.business: 西班牙基礎建設集團，旗下 Dragados 為 FCBC 成員。
vendors.businessEn: Spanish infrastructure group whose Dragados unit was an FCBC member.
vendors.role: 大跨橋梁施工與節段吊裝的承包商經驗
vendors.roleEn: Contractor experience in long-span bridge construction and segment lifting

vendors.name: 藍博（Ramboll）
vendors.business: 北歐工程顧問公司，主導承包商的細部設計聯合體。
vendors.businessEn: Nordic engineering consultancy that led the contractor’s detailed-design joint venture.
vendors.role: 多塔斜張橋細部設計與交叉索系統的工程經驗
vendors.roleEn: Engineering experience with detailed design of multi-tower bridges and crossing-stay systems

vendors.name: 傑可布（Jacobs）
vendors.business: 美國工程顧問公司，與 Arup 組成業主設計顧問聯合體。
vendors.businessEn: US engineering firm that formed the owner’s design consultancy joint venture with Arup.
vendors.role: 業主端標準設計、合約與專案管理的角色
vendors.roleEn: Owner-side specimen design, contract preparation and project management
